# arvados-login-sync

**Tag**: library

## 简介

Creates and updates local login accounts for Arvados users. Built from git commit 9bd831fc83c56113e2345ca2ea214bbd91cce728

- 主页: https://arvados.org
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/arvados-login-sync/3.2.1
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/arvados-login-sync
